name: Margin Call Response V 05
definition: Scope|The MarginCallResponse message is sent by the collateral giver or its collateral manager to the collateral taker or its collateral manager or vice versa. This is a response to the MarginCallRequest message. The margin call can be accepted, fully disputed or partially disputed.||The message definition is intended for use with the ISO20022 Business Application Header.||Usage|When sent by the collateral giver the MarginCallResponse message is used to:|- fully accept the MarginCallRequest|- or partially accept the MarginCallRequest.||When sent by the collateral taker the MarginCallResponse message is used to:|- fully accept the recall of collateral|- or partially accept the recall of collateral.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as know by the instructing party.

Obligation.name: Obligation
Obligation.definition: Provides information like the identification of the party or parties associated with the collateral agreement, the exposure type and the valuation date.

Agreement.name: Agreement
Agreement.definition: Agreement details for the over the counter market.

MarginDetailsDueToA.name: Margin Details Due To A
MarginDetailsDueToA.definition: Provides details about the margin calculation that would be due to party A.

MarginDetailsDueToB.name: Margin Details Due To B
MarginDetailsDueToB.definition: Provides details about the margin calculation that would be due to party B.

AgreedAmountDueToA.name: Agreed Amount Due To A
AgreedAmountDueToA.definition: Provides details about the agreed amount that would be due to party A.

AgreedAmountDueToB.name: Agreed Amount Due To B
AgreedAmountDueToB.definition: Provides details about the agreed amount that would be due to party B.

ResponseDetails.name: Response Details
ResponseDetails.definition: Provides response details about the margin call.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
